features: Moves full Live Screen Control into the main Live Screen Projector page after Event, Category and Round selection
Removes the need to navigate to a separate projection control page during normal operator workflow
Available rounds for the selected event/category are shown directly above the embedded control and can be switched without leaving the page
Embedded control contains Projector Live Feed Link, screen format/resolution, density, remote feed buttons and paging controls
Embedded mode hides duplicate navigation and event headers so the control feels like one continuous workspace
Screen setting Apply/Reset now returns to embedded mode instead of breaking out into a separate page
Mirrors same-page round/control workflow into Test Live Screen Projector
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
